user_query: I'm trying to adopt a more sustainable lifestyle. Can you calculate the carbon footprint of my daily activities and suggest ways to reduce it? Additionally, provide me with guidelines on eco-friendly email marketing practices.

TaskList.description: Collect data on daily activities to analyze carbon footprint.
Calculate the carbon footprint based on the collected daily activities data.
Provide suggestions on how to reduce carbon footprint based on the calculation.
Research and compile eco-friendly email marketing practices.
Provide eco-friendly email marketing guidelines based on research.
